from pathlib import Path
import json

root = Path.cwd()
life = json.loads((root / "control/control_center/lifecycle_status.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
index = (root / "control/control_center/static/index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

assert life["full_chain_status"] == "NOT_PROVEN"
assert life["invariant"] == "NO_TEST_OR_MEASUREMENT_BEFORE_ASTRA_POSTBUILD_APPROVAL"
candidate = life["current_candidate"]
assert candidate["current_stage"] == "astra_postbuild"
assert candidate["state"] == "PAUSED_AWAITING_POSTBUILD_DECISION_VERIFICATION"
assert candidate["scientific_status"] == "NO_PROVEN_EDGE"
assert candidate["postbuild_task_id"] == "DEV-PRED-A2Z-POSTBUILD-RETRY-20261006-E106"
stages = {s["id"]: s for s in life["stages"]}
for done in ("scout", "selection", "sol_design", "astra_prebuild", "sol_build"):
    assert stages[done]["current_candidate_state"] == "DONE", done
assert stages["astra_postbuild"]["current_candidate_state"] == "CURRENT_WAITING"
for waiting in ("measurement", "supervisor", "reporting"):
    assert stages[waiting]["current_candidate_state"] == "WAITING", waiting
assert "KANDIDAAT: HIER NU • WACHT OP SOL" not in index
assert "KANDIDAAT: HIER NU" in index
print("CONTROL_CENTER_A2Z_REFRESH_E001_OK")
